text: Become transparent to emotions. When a negative emotion comes, imagine that your body is not dense in its boundaries, but empty and having no boundaries. Close your eyes, and you will understand what I am talking about, feel that this is exactly how it is - it is unclear where you begin and where you end. Having directed attention to these sensations, you will automatically move into a meditative state. And here, allow the energy of this emotion (anger, sadness, resentment...) to pass through you without lingering, without leaving traces. If you are familiar with pranayama, support the process with breathing. Do not appropriate this emotion to yourself and do not associate it with yourself (I am angry), but observe it as a weather phenomenon (a storm front is passing). Feel yourself as open space - it is more interesting that way, and besides, that is exactly how it is.
